author: morphisec
text: Citrix confirms two NetScaler RCE zero-days exploited in attacks, shellcode placed directly into memory. Citrix confirmed CVE-2026-88771 and CVE-2026-88772, both CVSS 9.5, are actively exploited.

author: morphisec
text: CISA: ransomware gangs now exploiting critical TeamCity auth bypass (CVE-2026-63077). CISA updated its KEV listing for this critical JetBrains flaw to flag active ransomware exploitation.

author: binarly_io
text: New research: pre-auth RCE in Zyxel GS1900 exploited in the wild as a zero-day. The exploit was linked to CVE-2026-7273 (in KEV), but the patch did not stop the exploit.

author: swif_ai
text: Glow Labs: coding agents set up archived MCP servers recalled from training data. Their 4 high-severity flaws, incl. a prompt-injection RCE, won't be fixed. SCA misses them; check endpoint MCP configs.

author: HarshaHegde0
text: Glow Labs found coding agents installing archived MCP servers from training memory, 98% of deprecated installs they reviewed. Puppeteer MCP has an RCE via prompt injection; no patch. 17.3m npm downloads since Jul 2025.

author: Michaelzsguo
text: Binance published a detailed RFO/RCA on the October 29 cyberattack ($6.34B stolen). The attack started with a tampered developer tool and a fake job interview, then escalated through compromised laptops, internal AI tooling, and more.

author: robot2trade1
text: Binance initial findings on the Oct 29 incident trace a months-long campaign: in June a Wallet DevOps engineer downloaded a tampered Homebrew installer seeking an AI coding tool.

author: cubillas888
text: Supply chain attack, cPGuard: OPSSHIELD says unauthorized access to its update CDN let an attacker push a malicious script on Nov 2. Check install_log for 5.88.12-5.88.19, update to 5.88.25+, rotate DB and cloud keys if hit.

author: BadgerSignalHQ
text: Critical Langflow flaws enable unauthenticated bypass and RCE. IBM advisory discloses four vulnerabilities in the open-source AI workflow platform; two are critical (CVSS 9.8) and need no credentials.

author: Soar_Infosec
text: Self-managed GitLab CI/CD bug actively exploited (CVE-2026-97229): an unauthenticated attacker can put a crafted regex in a CI/CD config and run code on the server. Critical, CVSS 10.0.

author: paul_fregonese
text: CVSS 10.0, no auth: Siemens SIMATIC IoT2050 Advanced devices actively exploited to drop remote command backdoors, per VulnCheck (CVE-2026-58115, Node-RED).

author: joshmanders
text: They pulled credentials from inside their app's container and used them to request every secret on the platform, ours and every other customer's; they tried our cloud provider's metadata endpoint.

author: xcademialtd
text: Google warns of LLMjacking: attackers hijack compromised cloud accounts to access AI models and resell that access.

author: TPSaaS_io
text: n0n spent over $7,216 on AI services, SOCRadar reports. Every documented compromise relied on weak or stolen credentials.

author: Priyakachaliya
text: AU Small Finance Bank reported a potential data leak involving a third-party SaaS platform; up to 28.5 lakh vehicle loan customers may be affected.

author: CryptoMiners_Co
text: Mercado Bitcoin, Brazil's largest crypto exchange, suspended deposits, withdrawals and transactions after detecting $40M+ in unauthorized transfers from its hot wallets.

author: undercode_news
text: Amadeus airline distribution platform breach exposes passenger records across multiple airlines through stolen credentials.

author: nyuszkoreal
text: Critical zero-days actively exploited in the wild forcing urgent Chrome and Firefox patches.

author: kastralabs
text: PHP2Shell: unauthenticated RCE in the code behind ~70% of websites. Found by AI. Patched by humans.

author: morphisec
text: F5 BIG-IP APM zero-day CVE-2026-94127 actively exploited: unauthenticated RCE in BIG-IP APM's OAuth; 14,700+ instances exposed, added to CISA KEV.

author: cubillas888
text: MCPHub advisory: a non-admin could register an MCP server that forwarded other callers' Authorization and cookie headers (admins' included) to an attacker URL. Fixed in 1.1.8; CVE-2026-120323. Upgrade and rotate tokens.

author: D3bytes
text: PDF Reader MCP server authentication bypass: it read MCP_API_KEY and logged auth as enabled but never validated the key, so unauthenticated clients could access the MCP endpoint. CVE-2026-62264.

author: jondot
text: Copilot in Visual Studio could be tricked into editing its own .mcp.json: a write to '.mcp.json.' passed the filename check, Windows dropped the dot, and a new MCP server ran. CVE-2026-103572, fixed in October.

author: DailyDarkWeb
text: Prestige International breach: attackers took customer data from a roadside-assistance dispatch system used by subsidiary Prestige Core Solution, exposing up to 5.5M records.

author: TheBlockCo
text: Binance incident report: hackers used a fraudulent job interview to compromise an employee's computer, then leveraged an internal AI tool to reach wallet infrastructure and steal about $6.34B.

author: 2Workly
text: Attackers exploiting BTCPay Server <=2.4.1 to drain crypto hot wallets via stolen LND credentials. Upgrade to 2.4.7, rotate keys, rebuild affected instances.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: PHP2Shell CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 (CVSS 4.0 9.2): actively exploited unauthenticated RCE in PHP core; CISA added CVE-2026-109618 to KEV Oct 26, exploitation seen a day before fixes shipped.

author: Netlas_io
text: CVE-2026-58115: Actively exploited RCE in Node-RED (Siemens SIMATIC IoT2050), CVSS 10.0. Missing-authentication flaw lets unauthenticated remote attackers execute arbitrary system commands on exposed hosts.

author: DarkWebInformer
text: More than 1,000 GitLab servers remain exposed to an actively exploited RCE flaw CVE-2026-97229 (CVSS 10.0): unauthenticated code execution via a malicious regex in CI/CD configuration.

author: cybersec24h
text: 1,000+ GitLab servers still unpatched for CVE-2026-97229, CVSS 10, no account needed. CISA says it's actively exploited. GitLab fixed it Oct 12.

author: YourAnon_irc
text: Actively exploited Ivanti Connect Secure zero-days (CVE-2026-111357, CVE-2026-118527) via privilege escalation; patch immediately.

author: nurhayatdev
text: Actively exploited Cisco ASA/FTD VPN flaw CVE-2026-76418 lets an unauthenticated remote attacker force a reload when SSL remote-access VPN is reachable and secondary auth is configured (DoS, not RCE).

author: ido_cohen2
text: Linux Kernel CVE-2026-46300 actively exploited in the wild; allows root-level access via missing initialization flaw.

author: cybersec24h
text: Drupal Commerce Core flaw CVE-2026-118539 actively exploited: fraudulent $0.01 orders. Fixes: 3.3.13 and 8.x-2.41.

author: QFDNews
text: Microsoft warns PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619) and a Brotli flaw (CVE-2026-111497) are actively exploited. Update PHP, .NET, Node.js, PowerShell 7 and Visual Studio.

author: TweetThreatNews
text: Node.js October 2026 updates fix 10 flaws across 22.x, 24.x, 26.x incl. actively exploited critical Node2Shell Brotli flaw; removes trust in eight compromised eMudhra intermediate CA certs.

author: ESPProjects
text: Chrome: a critical flaw was being actively exploited; visiting a malicious page could put users at risk. Update and relaunch Chrome.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: CVE-2026-58115 (CVSS 10.0) in Siemens SIMATIC IoT2050 actively exploited via malicious Node-RED flows to plant Linux bots and HTTP exec backdoors.

author: cybersec24h
text: An AI found and exploited flaws in Chrome, Safari, Android, Windows and Linux. Anthropic says an unreleased internal model built 5 working attack chains; Linux kernel CVE-2026-98432 got remote root in ~53 minutes.

author: HacktronAI
text: A critical vulnerability in Dassault Systemes DELMIA Apriso went undetected through multiple security audits; Hacktron's AI found it in 10 minutes. It became CVE-2025-5086.
